title: Build and optimize slab models
action: Construct the Zn(100) surface slab from bulk hcp Zn (2x2 supercell, 20 atoms, 15 Å vacuum). Substitute one surface Zn atom with Cu to create the Cu-doped slab. Optimize the geometry of both slabs using DFT (GGA-PBE, D3 dispersion correction).
description: Optimized atomic structures are required for subsequent energy calculations. Provide a summary of final convergence (forces, energies) as evidence that the optimization was performed.

title: Compute DFT energies of reaction intermediates
action: For each slab (Zn and Cu-doped), compute total energies of the clean surface and of adsorbed *COOH and *CO intermediates at optimized geometries. Also compute gas-phase energies of CO2, H2O, and H2. Use the same DFT settings (PBE+D3). Apply zero-point energy (ZPE) and entropy corrections as appropriate for free energy calculations.
description: Raw total energies and corrections used to construct the free energy diagram. The agent should output a JSON file listing each system, state, total energy (eV), ZPE, and temperature correction.

title: Generate free energy diagram
action: From the calculated energies, compute the relative free energies of each intermediate state with respect to gas-phase CO2 and the clean slab (computational hydrogen electrode model at 0 V vs RHE). For both Zn(100) and Cu-doped Zn(100), list the free energies of *COOH, *CO, and the final CO(g) + clean surface. Write the results to free_energy_diagram.json.
description: Free energy profile for CO2 reduction to CO on Zn(100) and Cu-doped Zn(100) surfaces. Contains relative free energies (eV) of key intermediates referenced to CO2(g) + clean slab.
output_schema: An array of two objects. Each object has a 'system' key (string, one of 'Zn(100)' or 'CuZn(100)') and a 'steps' key (array of objects). Each step object has 'label' (one of 'CO2(g)', '*COOH', '*CO', 'CO(g)+*') and 'energy_eV' (float). The energy for 'CO2(g)' is defined as 0.0 eV.
